subject.title: improve(gateway): bound visible history page reads

question: After the parent generation-cursor PR is resolved, should gateway history adopt this opaque, generation-aware HTTP cursor as the supported continuation contract rather than preserve numeric cursors beyond the stated upgrade window?
rationale: This is a public gateway compatibility decision across an existing cursor format and a stacked persistence change; source inspection supports the implementation direction but cannot choose the permanent external contract without owner intent.

options.title: Adopt opaque cursor after compatibility window
options.body: Merge after the parent lands, rebase the child, and publish focused current-head proof for numeric-cursor compatibility and reset semantics.

options.title: Keep numeric cursor as the permanent HTTP contract
options.body: Retain numeric cursor responses and use the bounded reader only behind that existing wire format.

options.title: Defer visible-history follow-up
options.body: Keep the projection foundation only and revisit the HTTP/SSE cursor contract in a separately sponsored design discussion.

recommendation.title: Adopt opaque cursor after compatibility window
recommendation.body: Merge after the parent lands, rebase the child, and publish focused current-head proof for numeric-cursor compatibility and reset semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged active-projection and bounded-history foundation that defines the relevant gateway/storage boundary.
